chimera.verification: Exactly six articulated leg chains: 24 leg bones, six feet, 18 toes, and 18 shin plates. All 191 declared links connect. Top, side, and isometric evidence confirm six legs; this is no longer the rejected abstract four-legged proxy.

centaur.non_blocking_note: The side view and slatted shield remain the least faithful aspects, but the nested pilot legs, exoframe, weapon, shield contacts, and backpack read correctly.

zombie_devil.non_blocking_note: The viscera remain angular, and the two references are near-duplicates, so unseen geometry is correctly treated as unestablished.

audit: All four compiler audits report zero errors; only the intentional high-cuboid-count warning remains.

evidence_integrity.details: Metrics use raw fixed frames without fit, scale, translation, or recentering. Cameras are manually estimated and then frozen. Chimera display crops are common review crops only; recorded IoUs remain raw-frame values.

policy: Each selected asset passes only when every 1-4 rubric category is at least 3 and there is no critical structural mismatch. The cumulative gate passes only when all four assets pass.
